verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a command-line document-format converter and Haskell library. It does not host or analyze user data, so AI-generated insights and suggestions from data is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such AI insight capability; its filters and Lua extensibility are developer building blocks, not this feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
